{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Democrats believe they must be leaders in the new global economy, not followers.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Globalization is neither good nor evil; it is a fact.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Globalization will work for all Americans only if there are rules of the road that promote both a strong economy and American values.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Trade agreements should contain provisions to protect the environment and labor standards, as well as open markets in other countries.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Al Gore will insist on and use the authority to enforce worker rights, human rights, and environmental protections in trade agreements.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Trade should be used to lift up standards around the world, not drag down standards at home.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
